```text
Continue the work on the TokiGo project at:
C:\dev\TokiGo

Final requirements for the Travel News section on the home page:
1. The section title must be exactly “Travel News” in both Arabic and English.
2. News should appear inside a white container that fills the available screen width.
3. Inside the container, show short, low-height news strips displaying only the headline.
4. Scrolling must be horizontal, not vertical.
5. Remove the Refresh button from the section header.
6. Tapping a strip should open the story details inside the app. Show the headline and details written and edited by TokiGo’s AI, followed by a Sources label and a link to the original source that opens in the external browser.
7. News should cover travel, visas, flight disruptions, and travel advisories, using recent, verifiable sources.
8. Based on my request, “Add a tool to the project that it can use itself,” implement a real news-search tool in the backend and use it to gather results before sending them to the AI. Do not merely claim that the AI searches if the search actually happens elsewhere. Inspect the existing AI provider interface. If it does not support tool/function calling, implement a clear backend search tool that gathers and verifies results, then passes those results to the AI to write the stories. Use available integrations or the public RSS sources already used by the project. Do not add a paid service or assume an API key exists. Do not claim the system searches the entire internet or that the AI visited a link unless that actually happened. Preserve the real source and URL for every story, and do not let the AI invent or replace the source.
9. If search fails or the AI does not produce valid content, show an explicit error state. Do not display publisher text as if the AI wrote it.
10. Preserve the current worktree changes. Do not revert or clean unrelated files. Inspect the working-tree status before editing.

Current work to continue from:
- There is a NestJS service at `backend/src/modules/home/travel-news.service.ts`. It collects news from Google News RSS using four search categories, then uses `AI_PROVIDER` to generate headlines and story content. A `searchNewsSources` method was added, AI generation is now required rather than falling back to publisher text, the response has an `aiGenerated` field, and the cache key was versioned to `v2`.
- The test `backend/test/travel-news.service.spec.ts` covers AI generation, caching, and AI failure.
- The Flutter UI is in `lib/features/home/presentation/widgets/travel_news_section.dart`: it displays the title “Travel News”, has no visible refresh button, uses a 104px-high container, shows headline-only strips, and opens a bottom sheet with story details and a source link.
- The Flutter model is in `lib/features/home/domain/travel_news.dart` and uses `aiGenerated`.
- Translations are in `lib/l10n/app_ar.arb` and `lib/l10n/app_en.arb`; localization generation has been run.
- A UI test was added at `test/travel_news_section_test.dart`.
- Last verification before handing off: `flutter analyze` passed for the changed files; the Travel News UI test and carousel tests passed (8 tests total). The backend Travel News test passed (3 tests), and `npm run build` succeeded.
- The last hot-restart attempt was interrupted by a tool execution interruption. Reconnect to the running Flutter app through DTD, perform a hot reload or hot restart after any Flutter changes, and check for runtime errors.
- Generated localization files may have changed. Review `git status` carefully. Do not undo user changes or existing changes under `backend/dist`.

Implementation plan:
A. Inspect `git status` and the files listed above. Review how AI tools and search are defined in the project. Clearly distinguish between a backend search tool that runs before generation and tool calling performed by the model itself.
B. Complete and wire the search tool into the Travel News flow so it actually runs, with verifiable sources and links, request timeouts and size limits, deduplication, and appropriate caching. Do not add unconfigured permissions or API keys.
C. Verify that every AI-generated story has a non-empty headline and body, and retains the story ID, source, and URL from the search results. Reject incomplete or empty AI output.
D. Add or update backend and Flutter tests for the final requirements—especially that strips show headlines without details, tapping shows the details and source, and AI failure does not display misleading fallback content.
E. Run `dart format` on Dart files only, `flutter analyze`, the focused tests, and the backend tests/build. Fix only issues caused by this task.
F. Hot reload or restart Flutter on the connected device and confirm there are no runtime errors.
G. Finish with a brief English summary of the changes and tests. State precisely which search source is used and whether the model itself supports tool calling, or whether the backend passes the search results to it.
```
